episode_summary: Dan, Andrew and Anna host a Little Fish bonus episode reading listener-submitted mini-facts and then handing out ‘facts’ to Club Fish members, covering topics from rude historic names and pasta-timing playlists to supermarket etymology and sharks biting in their sleep.

facts.fact: In 1703, the high sheriff of County Cork in Ireland was split between two men, the high sheriff hood. I guess split between two men, named Dick Cox and Willie Supple.
And the fact is Berilla, the pastor company, Berilla, has a Spotify account with 10 different playlists. And the length of the playlist is the exact length of the time you need to cook that pastor.

The name of little comes from a guy called Ludwig Lidl, who was a retired school teacher and painter. So instead, he just thought Lidl is a good, short, powerful word, and I got to buy for 1,000 marks the name from Ludwig Lidl.
And this is that sharks can bite you in their sleep.
